summary: Tested the redesigned Private DNS/DoH Capability Diagnostic wizard (Preflight -> 7 steps). Confirmed via git diff that ALL frozen M2.1 Phase 6A files (src/harness/phase6*.ts, app/phase6-automated.tsx) are UNTOUCHED (zero diff output). Backend regression: 6/6 pytest passed (test_dns_diagnostics_receipts.py + test_m2_dns_capability_rule.py) against fresh isolated DB. Frontend: verified via Playwright at mobile viewport (375x667) that the Preflight step correctly renders 'Step 1 of 7 · Preflight', tapping 'Start diagnostic' calls activateWebsiteGateForDiagnostics() and shows 'Failed: NATIVE_MODULE_UNAVAILABLE (Expo Go / web -- a native Android build is required)' honestly, no Continue button appears (count=0), retrying ('Retry activation') re-runs the same call and still fails honestly with no crash and still no Continue button. Back button visible on step 1. /phase6-automated screen still loads correctly and unaffected. As anticipated in the review request, the DoT/DoH steps (steps 2-6) and the step>0 back-navigation path cannot be reached in this web/Expo Go preview since preflight blocks progression by design -- this was verified via deep code review instead (see below), not treated as a bug.

code_review_findings.dnsCapabilityDiagnostic.ts: pollForPrivateDnsRuntimeMode only resolves 'matched' when GuardDogNative.getDnsCapabilityDeviceSnapshot() freshly read on that tick equals targetMode exactly (line 140) -- no code path resolves matched without a genuine read. On Platform.OS!=android or GuardDogNative null, resolves 'unavailable' immediately, never silently proceeds. runPrivateDnsProbeForStep derives configurationLabel strictly from the freshly-captured truthSnapshot taken at probe-start (captureDnsDiagnosticTruthSnapshot call at line 227), and explicitly records drift if the fresh snapshot's mode differs from the poll-matched target mode (driftNote) instead of reusing the stale poll match -- correct per spec. No DoT step can reach a 'Continue' button without either pollPhase==='matched' (leading to stepResult via runPrivateDnsProbeForStep) or an explicit handleRecordDotNotTestable() call producing a NOT_TESTABLE record -- verified both UI paths (DotStepCard) only show Continue when stepResult is set.
code_review_findings.dnsCapabilityTruthSnapshot.ts: captureDnsDiagnosticTruthSnapshot returns an honest all-null/UNAVAILABLE snapshot with nativeAvailable:false and truthViolation:{violated:false,reasons:[]} when native module absent -- no throw, no crash path. computeTruthViolation correctly flags all 3 required conditions: (protectionState==='ACTIVE' && isVpnConsentRequired), (dnsGatewayActive && !tunOpen), and (probeRuleConfirmedInBundle===false) -- matches spec exactly.
code_review_findings.dns-capability-diagnostic.tsx: handleStartDohStep generates nonce via generateProbeNonce() (line 263) BEFORE capturing truthSnapshot (line 266) BEFORE Linking.openURL (line 272) -- correct order. finishDohObservation is wired to AppState 'active' transition (lines 208-218, gated by dohWentBackgroundRef to avoid firing on initial mount) AND a 125s fallback setTimeout (line 274) set right after openURL as a safety net if AppState never fires -- both paths call the same finishDohObservation(), which is idempotent-guarded (checks !observation early-return, and nulls dohObservationRef.current immediately) so a double-fire (AppState + fallback both racing) cannot double-process. Back button correctly branches: stepIndex>0 -> goToStep(stepIndex-1), stepIndex===0 -> router.back() (line 361) -- matches spec; not reachable live in this preview since preflight blocks progression, but the code path is directly verifiable by inspection.
code_review_findings.dnsCapabilityDiagnosticReport.ts: truthSnapshotSection(title, null) returns a safe placeholder ('Not captured this session') instead of throwing -- exportDnsCharacterizationJson/Pdf safe with preflightSnapshot:null. recordRow uses optional chaining (r.truthSnapshot?.truthViolation) and buildDnsCharacterizationHtml's records.map(...).join('') || fallback-row string handles an empty records array without throwing. Both export paths verified safe by static analysis for the two edge cases named in the review request.

verified_working.frozen_phase6_untouched: git diff --stat against src/harness/phase6AutomatedHarness.ts, phase6AutomatedReport.ts, and app/phase6-automated.tsx produced zero output (no changes). /phase6-automated screen loads correctly in preview with 'Run Automated Acceptance' button and Advanced/Diagnostics link intact.
verified_working.preflight_flow: Tapping 'Start diagnostic' -> 'Failed: NATIVE_MODULE_UNAVAILABLE (Expo Go / web -- a native Android build is required)' shown honestly, no Continue button rendered (count=0). Button relabels to 'Retry activation'; tapping it again re-runs the same call, still fails honestly, no crash, still no Continue button -- exactly the required 'no escape hatch' behavior.
verified_working.step_progress_ui: Progress dot bar (7 dots) and 'Step 1 of 7 · Preflight' label render correctly on initial load.
verified_working.backend_regression: 6/6 pytest passed: nonce receipt unknown/record/duplicate-post/malformed-nonce all correct; M2.1 dns-capability rule additive-append test + /api/config gateGuard.websiteGateRulesetId test both pass, confirming no backend regression from this frontend-only session.

action_items: No code fixes required. Everything reachable in the web/Expo Go preview behaves correctly per spec.

As already flagged by main agent: the DoT polling UI (steps 2-4), DoH steps (5-6), and final report step require a native Android build/physical device to be exercised end-to-end (native getDnsCapabilityDeviceSnapshot cannot run on web). Code review of the relevant TS logic and the new Kotlin function found no defects; this should be re-verified live on a native build when available.
critical_code_review_comments: GuardDogExpoModule.kt's new getDnsCapabilityDeviceSnapshot function correctly guards SDK_INT>=28 for LinkProperties.isPrivateDnsActive/getPrivateDnsServerName, falling back to UNSUPPORTED_OS_VERSION below API 28 rather than guessing -- matches the JS-side PrivateDnsRuntimeMode contract exactly (STRICT/ACTIVE_NO_HOSTNAME/INACTIVE_OR_OFF/UNSUPPORTED_OS_VERSION).
The change to GuardDogExpoModule.kt is purely additive (one new Function block appended, one new import block) -- verified via git diff, no existing Function/AsyncFunction bodies touched.

GuardDogExpoModuleDefinitionTest.kt was correctly updated to include 'getDnsCapabilityDeviceSnapshot' in the expected syncFunctions set, so the module-registration regression test will fail loudly if the new function is ever dropped or misregistered -- good test hygiene.

Minor observation (not a bug): dohFallbackTimerRef 125s fallback and the AppState-triggered finishDohObservation could theoretically race if AppState fires at nearly the same moment as the timer, but finishDohObservation's early-return-if-no-observation guard combined with immediately nulling dohObservationRef.current before any async work makes this race safe (verified by reading the exact ordering of statements).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable acceptance criteria in this environment (Preflight step, progress bar, retry-activation, back button visibility, phase6 regression); DoT/DoH steps 2-6 verified via code review only per the review request's own stated environment limitation

seed_data_creation: None persistent -- backend tests use isolated per-test DB fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The wizard's Preflight step, progress UI, and retry-activation no-escape-hatch behavior are confirmed correct in the web preview. Steps 2-7 (DoT polling, DoH probes, final report) are structurally unreachable here because activateWebsiteGateForDiagnostics() always returns ok:false without a native module -- this is by design and matches the prior testing agent's pattern for this screen family. All logic for those steps was reviewed statically and found correct (see code_review_findings). When a native Android build/device becomes available, prioritize live end-to-end verification of: (1) pollForPrivateDnsRuntimeMode actually timing out at 90s and offering Check again/Open Settings again/Record as not testable with NO continue-anyway option, (2) the DoH AppState-resume auto-completion actually firing without a second manual tap, and (3) exported JSON/PDF reports rendering the full truthSnapshot and preflightSnapshot correctly on a real device.
